about: Public data the validation suites use, downloaded and checked by node validation/fetch.mjs into validation/cache/<data set>/. Nothing here is stored in the repository or the MaveScape program. MaveDB's API writes its CSV files the same way each time (checked 2026-10-08); if a checksum stops matching, MaveDB has rewritten the file and the reference outputs that depend on it must be regenerated.

mavedb-grb2-sh3.title: GRB2 SH3 domain, Domainome abundance (urn:mavedb:00000835-a-1)
mavedb-grb2-sh3.description: Two populations (input and output of a yeast abundance selection, aPCA) × 3 biological replicates; 1,121 variants of a 56-residue domain (UniProt P62993, offset 158), WT row p.=. Scored by the authors with DiMSum 1.2.11 (absolute growth rates), rescaled so WT = 0 and the 2.5th percentile of missense variants = −1.

mavedb-brca1-ring.title: BRCA1 RING domain, E3 ligase activity (phage autoubiquitination) and BARD1 binding (Y2H) (urn:mavedb:00000003-a-1 and -a-2)
mavedb-brca1-ring.description: Time series: E3 ubiquitin ligase activity by phage autoubiquitination (selected with the E2, hence PlusE2 in the column names), 2 libraries × 3 replicates × 6 rounds (inputs shared within a library), and yeast two-hybrid, 2 libraries × 3 replicates × 4 time points (0/18/37/45 and 0/16/41/64 in the column names, units not stated in the record; non-uniform), in one count table. 909-nt DNA target (BRCA1 codons 2–304); -a-1 at nucleotide level (20,724 variants), -a-2 at amino-acid level (12,316). Scored by the Enrich2 authors with weighted least squares and random-effects combination; Enrich2's legacy _wt and _sy rows.
mavedb-brca1-ring.source: MaveDB; Starita et al., Genetics 2015 (doi:10.1534/genetics.115.175802), rescored in Rubin et al., Genome Biology 2017 (doi:10.1186/s13059-017-1272-5)

mavedb-factor9.title: Coagulation factor IX, MultiSTEP secretion, strep II tag (urn:mavedb:00001200-a-1)
mavedb-factor9.description: FACS bins: 3 tiles × 4 bins × 3 biological replicates; 9,682 variants of the 461-residue protein (WT row p.= in every tile). Scored by the authors as VAMP-seq weighted averages (bin weights 0.25–1), rescaled per replicate so the median of WT barcodes = 1 and the median of the lowest 5% of missense variants = 0, averaged over replicates.
mavedb-factor9.source: MaveDB; Popp et al., Nature Structural & Molecular Biology 2025 (doi:10.1038/s41594-025-01582-w)

mavedb-hsp90.title: Hsp90 (Hsp82) positions 582–590, growth over 21 generations (urn:mavedb:00000011-a-1)
mavedb-hsp90.description: EMPIRIC time series: every codon at nine positions of yeast Hsp90, one replicate sampled at 0, 3, …, 21 wild-type generations; 568 rows, one per codon variant, the wild type written once per position. Scored by the authors as the slope of log2(variant/wild type) on generations, null-like variants on the first three time points. The bundled example (web/examples/hsp90) is this counts file, unchanged.
mavedb-hsp90.source: MaveDB; Hietpas, Jensen and Bolon, PNAS 2011 (doi:10.1073/pnas.1016024108)

dimsum-demo.title: DiMSum's demo variant counts (TDP-43, lehner-lab/DiMSum inst/demo)
dimsum-demo.description: DiMSum's own count table: 40,591 whole nucleotide sequences (lower case; CRLF line ends, the last line unterminated) × 4 input and 4 output samples, and its experiment design file (old Mac line ends, CR only). The wild type, 126 nt (42 codons), is set in DiMSum's R/dimsum.R for --runDemo.
dimsum-demo.source: https://github.com/lehner-lab/DiMSum (Faure et al., Genome Biology 2020, doi:10.1186/s13059-020-02091-3)

mavedb-cbs.title: Cystathionine beta-synthase, yeast complementation at low and high vitamin B6 (urn:mavedb:00000005-a-5 and -a-6)
mavedb-cbs.description: Two population (non-selected and selected) counts by TileSeq, codon replacements of the 551-residue protein (UniProt P35520), relative allele frequencies scaled to counts (not whole numbers) after subtracting a non-mutagenized control. The low-B6 record has nonselect1–8 and select1–8 (nonselect5–8 repeat 1–4); the high-B6 record nonselect1–4 and select1–4. Wherever both records count a variant, their nonselect1–4 are the same: one set of inputs selected at two B6 levels (shared inputs). No wild-type row; about 500 synonymous rows (466 counted in every sample of both records); protein names repeat across codons (rows are unique by hgvs_nt).
mavedb-cbs.source: MaveDB; Sun et al., Genome Medicine 2020 (doi:10.1186/s13073-020-0711-1)

mavedb-pten-vampseq.title: PTEN abundance by VAMP-seq (urn:mavedb:00000013-a-1)
mavedb-pten-vampseq.description: Published scores only (no counts): VAMP-seq abundance of 4,409 PTEN variants, scaled with the wild type at 1 and nonsense at 0, with SEs, 95% intervals and each experiment's scores; six published calibrations in the record. The example opened from MaveDB (wave 3, slice 2).
mavedb-pten-vampseq.source: MaveDB; Matreyek et al., Nat Genet 2018 (doi:10.1038/s41588-018-0122-z)

mavedb-pten-phosphatase.title: PTEN lipid phosphatase activity (urn:mavedb:00000054-a-1)
mavedb-pten-phosphatase.description: Published scores only (no counts): lipid phosphatase activity of 8,680 PTEN variants in a humanized yeast model, scored with Enrich2 (fitness, the synonymous variants' 95% range -1.11 to 0.89 by the record's methods), with SEs and each replicate's scores. Another assay of the PTEN example's protein, compared with its abundance without opening it (wave 4, slice 3).
mavedb-pten-phosphatase.source: MaveDB; Mighell et al., Am J Hum Genet 2018 (doi:10.1016/j.ajhg.2018.03.018)

mavedb-brca1-sge.title: BRCA1 saturation genome editing (urn:mavedb:00000097-0-2)
mavedb-brca1-sge.description: 3,893 single-nucleotide variants of 13 exons of BRCA1 and their flanking introns, named on the RefSeq transcript NM_007294.3 (coding, splice-site, intronic and 5′ UTR), each scored by its depletion from HAP1 cells between days 5 and 11, with the library, plasmid and RNA counts the authors deposited. The example opened from MaveDB (wave 3, slice 3): a target named by its transcript, nucleotide variants read at the protein level.

mavedb-dhfr.title: E. coli DHFR, growth without and with the Lon protease (urn:mavedb:00000063-b-1 and -a-1)
mavedb-dhfr.description: Time series: every substitution of the 159-residue DHFR (UniProt P0ABQ4) complementing ER2566 ΔfolA ΔthyA in a turbidostat, sampled at 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16 and 18 hours, without Lon (-b-1, the parental B strain) and with Lon restored (-a-1). Four sub-libraries of 40 positions (1–40, 41–80, 81–120, 121–159), each grown three times, two in each of six repeats per condition, the repeats pairing the sub-libraries differently in each condition; each repeat also counts the library after transformation and after overnight outgrowth. Counts below 2 × 10⁻⁵ of the reads at a time point are not reported (NA). Scored by the authors with Enrich2's unweighted regression, each replicate scaled to the mean of all and averaged; _wt is the wild type's row.

mavedb-tp53-dbd.title: TP53 DNA-binding domain, deletions and insertions (urn:mavedb:00001277-a-1)
mavedb-tp53-dbd.description: Published scores of 8,058 variants of TP53's DNA-binding domain named on NM_000546.6: 5,609 deletions, insertions, duplications and deletion-insertions, 1,631 substitutions and 818 intronic variants. Each name's protein change checked against biocommons hgvs (validation suite consequences).
mavedb-tp53-dbd.source: MaveDB (urn:mavedb:00001277-a-1); its record names the publication (PMID 39774325)

mavedb-bap1-sge.title: BAP1 saturation genome editing, exon 1 (urn:mavedb:00000662-a-2)
mavedb-bap1-sge.description: 620 variants of BAP1's first exon and its flanks, named on the Ensembl transcript ENST00000460680.5: substitutions, single-base deletions and deletion-insertions in the 5′ UTR, the coding sequence and the intron.
mavedb-bap1-sge.source: MaveDB (urn:mavedb:00000662-a-2); its record names the authors and publication

mavedb-tp53-base-editing.title: TP53 base editing, etoposide (urn:mavedb:00001245-a-1)
mavedb-tp53-base-editing.description: 465 base-editor outcomes named as multi-variants on ENST00000269305.9 (c.[1144A>G;1145A>G;1146A>G]) beside their protein changes on ENSP00000269305.4: the published protein names a multi-variant's translation must give.

mavedb-varchamp.title: VarChAMP imaging, 28 targets (urn:mavedb:00001237-a-1)
mavedb-varchamp.description: 430 variants of 28 genes in one score set, each named with its target's label (LMNA:n.127G>A): a score set of several targets, opened one target at a time.
